The beetle exhibits a metallic emerald-green exoskeleton with distinct pale cream-colored markings on its elytra. Its head is broad with large compound eyes and visible mandibles. Long, filiform antennae extend outward. Six slender legs are visible, gripping the substrate. The lighting creates strong highlights on the iridescent shell.
